references.text: Abraham also asks his guests to stay while he fetches food for them, in the same way that Gideon asks the angel to wait
Lot insists that the angels stay and eat with him, showing hospitality similar to what Gideon shows
Manoah also offers a meal to the Lord's angel, parallel to Gideon's offer of a gift (mincha)
Jacob asks the divine figure to stay, similar to Gideon's prayer that the angel not depart
Mincha (food offering) is mentioned here as an offering brought before the Lord, using the same word that Gideon uses
The exhortation about hospitality, for some have unknowingly entertained angels - relevant to Gideon's encounter
